notes.title: September Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey folks, we're here to give you an update on the new things coming to Mirthwood as we draw closer to the end of the year. As always, thank you for your feedback! We monitor all of it as we continue to work on building & improving Mirthwood.



We've released a small update today with performance and early game improvements:

Performance optimizations

Updated early quests for smoother onboarding

Balance adjustments to reduce early game grind

Increased amount of seeds available for purchase from seeds vendor

Lowered cost of farm animals

Add lower cost (and slower) mount

You can now expand available tool slots (inventory)

New HUD notifications for important info (e.g. low hunger, weak tool, etc.)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/e45b24a5a53d646f9827bf59be6d7e9a99ca87c4.png"]


What's up next?
We're hard at work on some larger Mirthwood updates, which we plan to bring before the calendar turns to 2026 (...!). The dates here are subject to change (cuz game dev), but this is the target. We'll have more details and previews as we inch closer to each of these updates.




1. Steam Deck Verification (September-October)
Steam Deck Verification is just around the corner. We're making a few final tweaks based on Valve’s feedback (mostly minor scaling adjustments). That said... we’ve already put a lot of work into optimization of late, and the game runs well on Deck even now. So if you’re eager to dive in, go for it! Otherwise, the official Verified badge shouldn’t be far off.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/3f3678f2e5a5e2235749252383677694cdc9a4eb.png"]
2. Foundations Update (late October)
The foundations update will bring new features and content ranging from Festivals, to Random Encounters, to larger World Events. These additions will help to breathe new life into the world, and introduce life & death consequences to its denizens:

New World Events

New Seasonal Festivals

NPC Death (and replacement...)

Random Events & Encounters

Pets!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/80c7c76218b30816c97828eddb3158eab16ffa19.png"]


3. Online Multiplayer (November)
Online multiplayer development for Mirthwood is coming along well, and we expect it to be ready for release before the end of the year.




4. Seafarers Expansion (December)
Take to the sea and search for your family in a new story expansion, featuring new characters, quests, gameplay mechanics, cosmetics, and more:

Build up your customizable ship

Recruit a rag-tag crew

Brave the Sea and engage in different sailing activates

Make your way to new islands as you uncover the fate of your family

Grimrock awakens

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/3303a5f377f58646947a673d743e3be2fb43ff2e.png"]
Additions to Date
If you're new to Mirthwood and curious about what's changed since launch, here’s a snapshot of what's been added over the past few months:

Marriage & Children

Generated Quests

Reworked NPC Skills & NPC Hiring

Local Co-Op

Yuletide & Night of the Falling Stars Content

Optimizations to performance & combat

Steam Deck improvements (optimization, controls, scaling)


We've also returned the demo, so you can check that out if you're interested. If you enjoy the game, you'll be able to continue seamlessly from your demo save.

notes.title: Dev Update: May 2025
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Just wanted to check in and share what we’ve been working on.

Since the marriage update, our focus has been on bringing co-op functionality to Mirthwood. This is coming along nicely! When we get a bit closer we’ll share more details - but expect to play together remotely (through Steam remote play) or locally, while each managing your own inventories and skills.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/74ec76d83c51575ff9ca5ab9ca37a4ddcfbe6ec3.png
We’re also going to be working (with a partner) on porting to the Switch, which we’re excited about! However, this has required updating our Unity version, which is unexpectedly eating into some of the development time set aside for other roadmap items.

Beyond this, we’re continuing to work on additional content like children, instruments, and… something larger. But more on that later!

Thanks to all of you who have played, commented, and critiqued. We appreciate you all!

notes.title: Marriage Update is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

We're happy to announce a large update today centered around the addition of Marriage to Mirthwood. Without further ado, let's jump into what's in this update.


Marriage
You can now propose to any romanceable NPC in Mirthwood. Should your proposal be accepted, your spouse will move to the farm after a humble wedding ceremony.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/3e3003923314a110751b5ad72e0e5863d70af467.png


We've reworked NPC Skills with this update, so you may want to make sure you and your significant other are compatible long-term. Your spouse's Skills will determine the type of items they'll collect ( ...or destroy), while their overall happiness can affect their productivity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/ef47a084c55eda3f35cbcf7c9e0c3858052a0694.png

Your spouse will help out on the farm, and even give you tasks from time to time. Their are several "Spouse Types", which essentially determine your spouse's love language; some may prefer gifts, some conversation, while others may prefer acts of service. 

If ignored for too long... their productivity won't be the only thing to leave.


Hired Hands
You are now be able to hire NPCs to perform a number of different jobs - whether you need some help on the farm, or someone to brave the mines in search of ore. 

Learning what characters are skilled at will help you get the best results. Plus, if you're on good terms, they'll be more inclined to lower their price.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/def52f827eab0b8a3e295efd2444f9a0c3bd26e8.png



Layered Armor
We've added some new armor types: Cuirasses and Greaves. These plate armors can be equipped over your shirts and pants, giving much greater visual customization for you character and a wider variety armor to craft at your anvil.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/d1db79b836971364be9933f92ab02e832eeed448.png


Generated Quests
In addition to reworked Skills and Hiring, NPCs will now have occasional radiant quests for players. They'll ask for your help with different tasks: Hunting, gathering, bounties, deliveries, acquiring medicine, and more. Help them out or leave them hanging, the choice is yours.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/01e5e221ce3b200cad9c6950aa4eedda85534e24.png


What else?
There's still a bit more in this update. We've greatly expanded the types of fish that can be caught, added upgraded fishing rods, new recipes, diagrams, loot, and a Craftsman's Table to get to work on some new home goods. We added new Social tab to help keep track of relationships and hired hands, and you can now track NPCs on the map.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/4ae0b1bea249756d61a98d11547e7d81461ba19b.png


We hope you enjoy the update and, as always, let us know what you think. The best place to do so is in our wonderful Discord community. You can check out the full patch notes below.

In the meantime, we're getting right back to work on more for Mirthwood.



Patch Notes
Relationships & NPCs
- Reworked NPC/Spouse skill functions
- New “Social” tab to help keep track of relationships
- Player can now track NPCs on the map
- Players can now give Gifts to NPCs
- NPCs can now be Hired to perform different jobs
- NPCs will best perform tasks suited to their Skills
- Unlock Skills/Traits through chat, gifts, and quests
Marriage
- Players can now marry an NPC
- Spouses will move to the farm and help with tasks
- Spouses will gather (or lose) materials based on their skills
- Spouses will give the player occasional tasks
- Spouses can become unhappy and leave if ignored
- Spouse happiness can affect productivity
Generated Quests
- NPCs will now offer the Player radiant quests
- Completing (or ignoring) accepted quests will affect relationship levels
- Spouses will give the Player occasional tasks
Layered Armor
- You can now equip plate armor on top of shirts, dresses, brigandines, etc.
- You can now equip greaves on top of pants
- New armor & diagrams can be found at blacksmiths or through exploration
New Items
- New craftable fishing rods to make fishing more manageable
- More than doubled the number of fish types to catch
- New recipes & meals
- New Craftsman’s Table for crafting furniture
- New armor types
Other
- Add ranged enemy type
- Refreshed pause/settings menu UI
- Various balance adjustments
- Fast Travel locked until gathering a Binding Stone

notes.title: Mirthwood finally adds marriage in huge, smooch-filled update, and it's on sale
notes.notes:
Stardew Valley truly pioneered the cozy game genre. It has everything from crafting to farming, and from dynamic villager relations to fully-rounded romance. As a result, it feels like every life game has to have those exact same elements - realistically, we all just want to smooch our favorite villagers. Mirthwood, a farming sim that transports Stardew's traditional mechanics into a hand-drawn, Fable-esque world, has sadly been lacking in the marriage department, but not anymore. Rejoice, my hopeless romantics: Mirthwood is finally letting you tie the knot, and it's currently available at a discount.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Patch 1.0.30p2 - Combat Changes
notes.notes:
Hello folks,

Just dropping by to provide a brief update on some changes we've made to combat. The changes are mainly centered around the usage of stamina/energy during combat, or when sprinting or dodging.

Stamina is based on your current Energy, and is drained when sprinting or performing combat actions. After a short delay, it starts to regenerate. You will also now face the mouse when in combat and attack in the mouse/stick direction instead of facing the closest enemy. Enemies also move slightly faster when trying to get in attack range.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/b391abe152556cfd9ce46ccab4f068d2178037c9.gif

The goal here is to prevent the easy spamming of attacks that removes all thought/effort from combat, while also making managing your energy level more important before engaging in fights.

If you're not into these changes, don't worry! They do make combat more challenging, but you can easily turn them off in settings.

While we have much more planned, this is a first step toward improving the combat experience in Mirthwood - and of course - we always have an ear out for your feedback.

Once more, we recommend joining the Discord! It's the best place to get a peek at upcoming content, provide feedback, submit bugs, and just hang out with the community.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello Folks!

We’re excited to share some important updates with you regarding the progress of Mirthwood.

As many of you know, we initially postponed our launch from September 11, 2024, to November 6, 2024. This decision was made to ensure that the game is as optimized and polished as possible before it reaches your PCs.

Today, we're pleased to confirm that we are on track for the November 6 release. Barring any unforeseen circumstances, Mirthwood will be available for purchase and download on the scheduled date.

Our focus for the launch is to integrate several key elements from our previously released roadmap into the day-one version of the game. We're working tirelessly to include everything we’ve planned right from the start. Additionally, game optimization remains a top priority, with the goal of ensuring Mirthwood runs smoothly on the Steam Deck! We’re also working hard to provide localization in multiple languages, and we’ll share more updates as we get closer to the official release.

On the weekend of September 21, we hosted a closed beta event, announced via our Discord. Nearly 700 players participated, and their feedback has been invaluable to Mirthwood’s development. We are incredibly grateful to everyone who took part—your input has been instrumental.

If you haven’t already, we warmly invite you to join our growing Discord community. Since September, the Mirthwood Discord has grown significantly, and it’s the best place to stay informed about our development progress. It’s also the only way to sign up for our next closed beta, which is planned for mid-to-late October.

The support we’ve received from this community has been nothing short of remarkable and truly humbling. We firmly believe that our decision to delay was the right one, and we can’t wait for Mirthwood to charm and captivate you when it launches. Thank you again for your continued support, and we look forward to seeing you soon!

Warm regards,

Daron & Brian
